reuse.why: All month-wide actions share the new category selector and reuse existing tag parsing, month utilities, spreadsheet access, budget writes, and undo wrappers.

duplication.why: The selector removes repeated category queries, although the new action repeats the income eligibility guard retained in existing actions.

placement.why: Category eligibility and spending calculations live alongside existing budget actions, with method registration in the established app layer.

scope.why: Changes are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, and relevant tests.

maintainability.why: The shared selector makes exclusions straightforward to maintain, though income eligibility remains distributed across individual actions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every affected month-wide action calls getMonthWideCategories, and the new action uses existing infrastructure helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: Repeated category queries are replaced with shared selection rather than renamed or reshaped copies.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideCategories gains the requested includeHiddenCategories parameter and one conditional selecting the hidden-category SQL filter; all affected callers continue through it.
